title: 疑问词 + to do / too…to / enough to

examples.en: I don't know what to do next.
examples.zh: 我不知道下一步做什么。

examples.en: The box is too heavy to carry.
He is old enough to go to school.

guess.question: I don't know what to do 里的 what to do 是什么结构？

options.text: 疑问词 + to do 构成的短语，相当于一个简化了的从句
options.feedback: 对！它等于 what I should do，但更短，且不用倒装。
不对——what 是 do 的宾语，整个短语作 know 的宾语。
不对——这是陈述语序的短语，没有问号和倒装。

rule.rule: 疑问词 + to do 可作宾语；too + 形容词 + to do 表示“太……而不能”；形容词 + enough + to do 表示“足够……可以做”
signals: what / how / where / when + to do
rule.formula: ① 疑问词 + to do：I don't know how to get there.　② too + adj. + to do：too young to go　③ adj. + enough + to do：old enough to join

anchors.en: I don't know how to get to the station.
She is old enough to join the army.

trap.wrong: I don't know what to do it.
trap.right: I don't know what to do.
trap.why: what 本身就是 do 的宾语，后面不能再加 it。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——三个公式：疑问词+to do、too…to（太……不能）、adj.+enough+to do（够……可以）。

check.stem: — I don't know ____ to get to the station. — Let me show you the way.

options.distractor: 答语是指路，问的是怎么去

check.explanation: 不知道怎么去 → how to get there。

check.stem: The boy is ____ young ____ go to school.

options.distractor: very 不与 to do 构成此结构
enough 要放在形容词后面

check.explanation: 太小不能上学 → too young to go。

options.text: He is old enough to go to school.
The box is too heavy to carry.
I don't know how to do it.
I don't know what to do it.

check.explanation: what 已是 do 的宾语，不能再加 it，应改为 what to do。
